input.sql: SELECT * FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0 OR "INV_ID" IN (SELECT min("INV_ID") FROM "APINVH")

SELECT h.*, (SELECT sum("DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") dr, (SELECT sum("CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") cr FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH")

SELECT h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG", l."ACCT_CD", count(*) n, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr, count(DISTINCT h."JRNL_NO") j FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3
SELECT "SRC_CD", "SRC_REF", count(*) n, min("MEMO") mn, max("MEMO") mx, min("POST_DT") d0, max("POST_DT") d1 FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,3 DESC
